slide.title: Review slides publish through the same transaction
slide.takeaway: apply-slide --review publishes review slides like deck slides; their Items get code only from cover, which stays attached across revisions.

item.label: apply-slide --review uses the slide transaction
item.description: The review deck comes from --review, the request's review field, or the deck URN. Merged reviews and mismatched decks are refused, and publication follows the same lock, idempotency and snapshot rules.

references.note: Routing a request to a review deck.
Routing a request to a review deck.
Routing a request to a review deck.
Publish, cover, and an edit that keeps coverage.

criterion_links.rationale: A review slide publishes a diagram source rendered to SVG, or an asset, through the same transaction as a deck slide.

item.label: Review Items carry no evidence or criterion links
item.description: A review Item that carries evidence or criterion links is refused, with a pointer to cover --target ITEM --changed-lines; implementation Items still need exact evidence and carry no record.

references.note: The review and implementation Item checks.
The review and implementation Item checks.
The review slide guards.

criterion_links.rationale: A review Item's code comes only from cover, pinned to the review's own range.

item.label: Cover records stay attached across revisions
item.description: The loader lets flat cover records attach to review transaction Items, so coverage survives every revision and a migration from a hand-written slide; the migrated snapshot drops a review Item's evidence.

references.note: Flat records attaching to review transaction Items.
Flat records attaching to review transaction Items.
Flat records attaching to review transaction Items.
Flat records attaching to review transaction Items.

criterion_links.rationale: cover's pinned references stay attached to the review Item across every slide revision.

item.label: Covered or commented Items cannot be removed
item.description: admitReviewItems refuses an update that drops or renames an Item still named by a coverage record or a review comment, since either would be left pointing at nothing.

references.note: admitReviewItems.

criterion_links.rationale: An Item a comment is attached to cannot be dropped or renamed, so the comment keeps its slide context.

item.label: diagram edit, describe and check take --review
item.description: Review slides resolve by URN or --review; edit rebuilds the complete request from the revision, keeping the review, and check reports a merged review's stale slides as history.

references.note: Finding and editing a review slide; check of merged reviews.
Finding and editing a review slide; check of merged reviews.
Finding and editing a review slide; check of merged reviews.

criterion_links.rationale: A review slide's diagram is edited and checked against its source like any diagram-sourced slide.

item.label: visual-qa --review renders in the review viewer
item.description: Selects the review deck's slides, refuses --feature and a foreign deck, and renders each through /reviews/<id>/visual/<slide> as the reviewer shows it.

references.note: Selecting and rendering review slides.
Selecting and rendering review slides.
Review slide selection.

criterion_links.rationale: Review slides are rendered and checked at both sizes as the reviewer shows them.
